b'# tinydl

A tiny command line tool for downloading files over HTTP(S).

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [options]
```

## Options

| Option | Help Text |
| ------ | --------- |
| `url` | what to download (positional argument) |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

Run `tinydl --help` to see these options directly from the CLI.
'
